description: **Accounts Assistant – Financial Services** **Location:** South Dublin **Working Model:** Hybrid Abrivia Recruitment is recruiting an Accounts Assistant to join the finance team of an established financial services organisation based in South Dublin. This position will focus primarily on accounts receivable and credit control, including managing customer payments, monitoring outstanding balances and resolving account queries. You'll also gain exposure to reconciliations, month-end activities and the wider finance function. This is a great opportunity for someone with 1–2 years' experience in accounts or finance who is looking to build on their existing skills in a busy and supportive team environment. **Your Role** * Monitor incoming payments and ensure customer accounts are accurately maintained. * Review outstanding balances and follow up with customers to support timely collection of payments. * Investigate payment discrepancies and resolve account-related queries. * Assist with invoicing, payment allocation and account reconciliations. * Work closely with internal teams to address billing issues and outstanding payments. * Support month-end activities, including debtor reporting and maintaining accurate financial records. * Maintain customer account information and ensure financial data is kept up to date. * Contribute to improvements in finance processes and systems. **Your Skills** * 1–2 years' experience in an accounts, finance assistant or similar role. * Previous exposure to accounts receivable, credit control, invoicing or reconciliations. * Intermediate Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems. * Strong attention to detail and good numerical skills. * Excellent communication and organisational skills. * Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a busy environment. * A proactive attitude and willingness to learn. **What's on Offer?** * Hybrid working – 3 days in the office and 2 days remotely following initial training. * Performance bonus. * Employer pension contribution. * Healthcare discount. * Life assurance. * Free on-site parking. * Opportunity to develop your experience within a financial services finance team. If you're looking to take the next step in your accounting career and would like to learn more about this opportunity, please apply or contact **Aoife Davis at Abrivia Recruitment** for a confidential discussion.

title: Analytical Test Technician
description: **Location:** Leixlip, Kildare **Department:** Quality / Construction **Reports To:** Analytical Testing Lead / Project Quality Manager **Job Summary:** We are currently recruiting Analytical Test Technicians, within our FSR division to support our activities in the semiconductor industry. The Analytical Test Technician will be required to test for leaks and impurities in process pipe systems. These systems include UHP (Ultra High Purity) gas lines as well as UPW (Ultra-Pure Water) systems. Hands on troubleshooting is part of the work performed. Testing is mainly conducted in clean-room and manufacturing type settings. **Key Responsibilities:** * Perform leak detection and impurity testing in process piping systems, including Ultra High Purity (UHP) gas lines and Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) systems * Conduct hands-on troubleshooting and diagnostics in cleanroom and high-volume manufacturing environments * Specialise in Helium Leak Testing to verify system integrity and prevent contamination risks * Execute Particle Analysis to ensure compliance with stringent cleanliness standards * Perform Moisture and Oxygen Testing to maintain purity levels in critical gas delivery systems * Carry out Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and water quality testing for UPW systems * Provided facilities support, including system maintenance, validation, and operational troubleshooting * Supported third-party quality assurance activities, ensuring adherence to regulatory and industry standards **Requirements** * 1-2 years of experience in construction, trade environments, or other hands-on assembly-related roles * Previous experience in analytical testing is advantageous * Demonstrated ability to safely operate a range of hand and power tools * Strong proficiency in measurement techniques and basic mathematical calculations * Experience in process pipe and tube welding is considered a plus **Desirable:** * Valid Safe Pass and Manual Handling certification * Experience in regulated environments (e.g., semiconductor, pharma, data centres, or cleanroom projects) * Proficiency with digital QA platforms and reporting tools (e.g., EIDA, BIM 360, or similar) **Working Conditions:** * Site-based role with regular inspections in active construction environments * All personnel are required to adhere to site rules and always wear the appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) **Benefits** * 45 hour week - dayshift * Hours - 7 - 430pm * 16 euro an hour * Exposure to advanced semiconductor technologies * A professional and supportive team

title: Application Engineer (m/f/d) - Ireland
description: **Company Description** **INFICON** is a leading provider of innovative measurement instruments, critical sensor technologies, and software solutions for smart manufacturing/Industry 4.0 that improve the productivity and quality of tools, processes, and entire factories. These analysis, measurement, and control products are essential for detecting gas leaks in HVAC and automotive manufacturing. They are critical for equipment manufacturers and end users in the complex production of semiconductors and thin-film coatings for optics, flat-panel displays, solar cells, and industrial vacuum coating applications. Other users of our vacuum-based processes include the life sciences, research, aerospace, the packaging industry, heat treatment, laser cutting, and many other industrial processes. We also leverage our expertise in vacuum technology to offer unique products for the analysis of toxic chemicals in the fields of disaster response, security, and environmental health and safety. **Job Description** **Field Service & Technical Support** * Deploy, install, and configure FabGuard monitoring systems across multiple tool groups (Etch, CVD, PVD, Litho, etc.) * Provide on-site troubleshooting and technical support for FabGuard software, hardware, and data acquisition * Diagnose and resolve Windows system issues; perform PC installation, configuration, and cabling * Create recipes and data analyses using FabGuard for Fault Detection and Classification (FDC) * Deliver customer training on INFICON products; identify improvement opportunities and new application areas * Provide written and oral feedback on applications, process optimization, and installations **Data Acquisition & Systems Integration** * Configure and maintain data acquisition parameters between FabGuard and connected systems * Support integration projects involving industrial protocols (OPC-UA, SECS/GEM, TCP/IP, etc.) * Test and validate software updates; troubleshoot connectivity issues and data discrepancies **Stakeholder & Site Coordination** * Serve as on-site point of contact for our customers' teams across multiple fabs * Coordinate with out customer' teams (process engineering, equipment groups) on equipment readiness and logistics * Report site status and escalate risks to INFICON EMEA and US management **Reporting & Process Improvement** * Contribute to regular site status updates; identify and propose process improvements **Knowledge Transfer & Training** * Train our customers and contractor teams on FabGuard procedures; document site-specific configurations * Provide cross-coverage support to other field colleagues as needed **Qualifications** * Technical diploma or degree in electronics, automation, industrial systems, or equivalent professional experience * Solid working knowledge of Windows operating systems, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting * Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and OEM equipment, including lithography, PVD, and CVD technologies * Basic knowledge of vacuum pump and abatement system operation * Demonstrated ability to test and validate software in industrial and manufacturing environments * Comfort working in cleanroom environments and compliance with all cleanroom procedures * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to engage directly with customer stakeholders * Prior experience in semiconductor fabrication environments is preferred * Familiarity with industrial protocols (OPC-UA, SECS/GEM, Modbus TCP) is a plus * Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an asset **Additional Information** **INFICON** offers a dynamic work environment that promotes diversity, equality, and inclusion. Our respectful, innovative, and vibrant corporate culture is evident in everything we do and how we do it. **What can you expect from us?** * Smart and friendly colleagues who value team spirit, a positive attitude, and reliability - and who always make sure there’s plenty of fun to be had * Opportunities to share bold ideas and contribute creatively * Flexible work hours * Competitive salary, excellent benefits, plus profit sharing * Opportunities for continuing education and professional development * Celebrating successes together and dealing openly with failures - they’re invaluable for our continuous growth * Regular employee events **Take your next career step with us!** Would you like to learn more about us and find out what it’s like to be part of the INFICON family? title: Associate - ISIF Investments
description: **Job Title: Associate - ISIF Investments** **Division/Function: Ireland Strategic Investment Fund** **Contract Type: 23 Month FTC** **Commencement Date: September 2027** * Closing Date for Applications: 9th October 2026 \*\*\*\* **Summary of the Business:** The National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) provides asset and liability management services to the Irish Government. It has evolved from a single function agency managing the National Debt to a manager of a complex portfolio of public assets and liabilities. Businesses managed by the NTMA include borrowing on behalf of the Government and the management of the National Debt, the State Claims Agency, the New Economy and Recovery Authority (“NewERA”), the Ireland Strategic Investment Fund, National Development Finance Agency and the NTMA Future Ireland Funds business unit with responsibility for the management of the Future Ireland Fund and Infrastructure, Climate and Nature Fund. The NTMA also assigns staff to the Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland (SBCI) and Home Building Finance Ireland (HBFI). **Role Summary:** **This is an exciting opportunity for talented and motivated graduates to join the ISIF division of the NTMA on a 23-month Associate Programme commencing in September 2027. The programme is open to graduates with a degree in Finance / Economics / Commerce / Accounting / Law / Science / Computer Science / Mathematics / Engineering or a related discipline** **.** **The Ireland Strategic Investment Fund (ISIF) division:** **The Ireland Strategic Investment Fund (ISIF) sources and completes investments on a commercial basis in a manner designed to support economic activity and employment in Ireland. This strategy focuses on long-term transformational investments addressing key strategic challenges facing the country. These include climate action, housing and enabling infrastructure, scaling indigenous businesses, and food and agriculture. In addition, ISIF has flexibility to invest in national and compelling investments in response to future events. See www.isif.ie for more detail. Alongside its portfolio of Irish focused investments, ISIF maintains a diversified public markets portfolio (the ISIF Funding Portfolio) which provides liquidity to fund ISIF’s ongoing commitments while contributing to ISIF’s net returns.** **Within the ISIF unit, there are three distinct functions: Investment, Portfolio Management, and Operations.** **The Associate will work in** **ISIF’s Investment function** **, (either in the Irish portfolio or the ISIF Funding Portfolio) alongside colleagues across the full range of ISIF's investment, portfolio management, and operational activities. By the end of the programme, successful candidates will have developed a strong knowledge base across all areas of the ISIF team and the investment process. This may include experience in research, due diligence, and evaluation of investment opportunities, measuring, monitoring, and managing key aspects of the portfolio, such as risk management, asset allocation, investment performance, ESG considerations, and data analytics.** **At the end of the programme the successful Associate will have developed a solid knowledge base of the ISIF unit and the wider NTMA.** **Working at the NTMA offers excellent benefits including:** * Competitive salary and 23 days annual leave * Career average defined benefit pension scheme * Education funding and paid study leave * Reimbursement of annual professional membership fees * Excellent learning and development opportunities that allow for full career development within the organisation * Extensive workplace wellbeing programme * State of the art facilities with sustainable modern workspaces * Advanced technology enabling flexible and hybrid work options * A diverse range of initiatives: LGBT+, Gender Matters, Disability Advocacy, Sports & Social, Volunteering and lots more. **Learning and Development:** Typically, Associates within this division also undertake professional examinations which are supported through the full range of NTMA study supports, complemented by a comprehensive Associate Development Programme, an Associate network spanning the NTMA, and extensive on-the-job learning opportunities. **Do you have what it takes?** Are you ambitious, commercially minded and diligent? Do you have what it takes to excel in a challenging, fast-paced team environment? Do you have the flexibility to adapt to different environments and responsibilities? Successful candidates will have a minimum of a 2.1 honours degree or a minimum of a 2.1 Masters, ideally in a related discipline. Applicants must have the correct legal status to work in Ireland (Irish Citizen, EEA Citizen, Stamp 4, Stamp 1G Visa). The NTMA are strong believers in the value a diverse work force brings to our business endeavours. We are able to accommodate candidates with a disability at every stage of our process. Should you need any additional support, please don’t hesitate to contact our Disability Liaison Officer - Laura Finnegan **Pension Abatement** If an appointee has previously been employed in the Civil or Public Service and that appointee is entitled to or in receipt of a pension from the Civil or Public Service or where a Civil/Public Service pension comes into payment during the appointee’s re-employment that pension will be subject to abatement in accordance with Section 52 of the Public Service Pensions (Single Scheme and other Provisions) Act 2012. Please note: In applying for this position, you are acknowledging that you understand that the abatement provisions, where relevant, will apply. Applicants will be required to complete a pre-employment declaration to confirm whether they have previously availed of a Public sector pension scheme. The NTMA is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We recognise that a diverse and inclusive workplace informs better decision making, creative thinking, innovation and drives business performance. We are strongly committed to ensuring that our workforce is representative of our society.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards. Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards. **Who are we looking for?** =========================== * You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds. * You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business * You are a creative problem-solver * You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset * You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning * You thrive in a team environment * You have excellent interpersonal skills * You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment You are fluent in English is Essential **What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?** ================================================== **The program is structured as follows:** ----------------------------------------- **Introduction Month** ---------------------- **During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values * Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools * Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce * Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni **Rotations** ------------- * During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path. * If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond. Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion. **Examples of what you can expect during the rotations** ======================================================== **Sales Graduate Rotation** --------------------------- * Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies * Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects * Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation **Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation** ------------------------------------------ * Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level * Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations * Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view **What’s in it for you?** ========================= * A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation * The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment * Access to our diverse internal employee groups * A comprehensive benefits package * Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process * An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model **Map your future for the coming years** ======================================== With the EMEA Graduate Program - Sales Path, you can continue to progress: * After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. **Posting Statement** Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. Our Critical Systems teams have worked on a range of amazing projects, from data centres for large tech companies to headquarters of companies such as Deutsche Bank and Diageo. Working closely with colleagues across our multi-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors including education, healthcare, workplace, retail and critical systems (data centres). title: Graduate Policy Analyst/Economist in the Irish Government Economic & Evaluation Service
description: **Job title:** Graduate Policy Analyst/Economist **Employer:** The Irish Government Economic & Evaluation Service **Location:** Dublin **Closing Date:** 3pm, Thursday, 22nd October 2026 **Starting Salary:** €41,176 **About the Employer:** The Civil Service is at the heart of Irish society making a vital contribution to Irish life. Everything the Civil Service does, from carrying out the work of Government to delivering frontline public services, impacts our country, and most importantly, our people. The Civil Service is now recruiting for Graduate Policy Analysts / Economists with relevant qualifications to undertake national policy development roles in the Irish Government Economic and Evaluation Service (IGEES). This is an exciting opportunity for those embarking on their professional careers to bring the tools and techniques of economic and policy analysis to support evidence informed policymaking, in order to deliver better public services and improve outcomes for citizens. The successful candidates will be offered a meaningful, satisfying and varied career, with competitive terms and conditions. Established in 2012, the Irish Government Economic and Evaluation Service (IGEES) is an integrated cross-Government service that supports better policy formulation and implementation in the civil service through policy analysis and evaluation. IGEES offers wide ranging employment opportunities across Government Departments in analytical roles across all policy areas (e.g. transport, housing, education, social protection, climate action, etc.), as well as macroeconomic forecasting, expenditure and fiscal policy. IGEES is working to build economic and evaluation capacity across the civil service and to embed an evidence-informed approach to policy analysis, design and implementation. This will contribute to the achievement of better policy outcomes and better value for money for the public. The primary aims of IGEES are to: • develop policy analysis and evaluation capacity within the Civil Service through recruitment and learning and development; • ensure application of established best practice in policy analysis and evaluation in support of better value for money and more effective policy; and • facilitate more open policy dialogue with academia, external specialists and stakeholders across the broad socio-economic spectrum. **About the Role:** The Graduate Policy Analyst/Economist role provides successful candidates with the opportunity to contribute to the development of national policy. There are IGEES Graduate Policy Analyst/Economist roles in every Government Department across the Dublin region. IGEES offers wide ranging employment opportunities, in analytical roles in government departments, working across different policy areas (e.g. transport, housing, education, social protection, climate action, etc.), as well as macroeconomic forecasting, public expenditure and fiscal policy. The work varies depending on the requirements of the Department to which successful candidates are assigned, but typically covers one or more of the following: • Contributing to national policy development across a wide range of areas; • Using data, quantitative and qualitative tools and techniques to conduct policy analysis and evaluation; • Contributing to appraisals and evaluations of significant areas of expenditure in line with the Public Spending Code; • Economic modelling and forecasting; • Contributing to briefing and advising senior officials and Ministers; • Providing technical advice and guidance to ensure effective regulation. **About You:** Candidates must have on or before 31st October 2027: 1. a) A qualification at Level 8 (minimum 2.1 honours degree) on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) (or NARIC Ireland Foreign Qualifications equivalent) in a relevant discipline such as Economics, Social Science, Policy Analysis or Statistics or b) A post graduate qualification at Level 9 on the NFQ or NARIC Ireland Foreign Qualifications equivalent in a relevant discipline such as Economics, Social Science, Policy Analysis or Statistics AND 2. Successfully demonstrate the required capabilities for this role. In addition, candidates should demonstrate: • strong communication (oral and written), presentation and interpersonal skills • the capacity to carry out research, analysis and problem solving • the ability to work as part of a team • ability to work in a fast-paced environment and to tight deadlines • the capacity to develop leadership capability and lead in your area of expertise • the capacity to show initiative and to develop leadership capability • experience of producing results to specified deadlines. It is expected that from the outset, successful candidates will be able to make a substantive contribution to the work of the Civil Service. While training is to a significant extent ‘on the job’, induction and training courses in specific skills and areas of work will be provided to assist you to become familiar with the public sector. Further information including details on how to apply for this position is available on www.publicjobs.ie. The closing date for receipt of completed applications is 3pm on Thursday, 22nd October 2026. We are committed to a policy of equal opportunity and encourage applications under all nine grounds of the Employment Equality Act.

title: Healthcare Assistant (Theatre) - UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic, Dublin
description: Location: Sports Surgery Clinic Job type: Permanent **Overview Of Role** UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic are currently recruiting for the role of Healthcare Assistant in our Theatre department. **Primary Duties And Responsibilities** * Respect the privacy and dignity of patients whilst carrying out planned care duties. * Present for duty in a professional manner, punctually and correctly dressed according to Theatre policy. * Help with patient mobility by accompanying patients when walking. * Assist Consultants as leg holder in Theatre for procedures. * Assist with moving and positioning patients under the direction of the Anaesthetist and nursing staff. * Moving patients between theatre table, beds, trolley’s using sliding roll board with support from the theatre staff, following the manual handling assessment of individual patients. * Communicate and pass on relevant information to the ward team. * Communicate verbally with Theatre staff and colleagues on issues relating to work schedules or any problems on a daily basis. * Attend departmental and team meetings. * Attend mandatory training e.g. CPR, Patient Moving & Manual Handling, Fire Training etc. * Communicate verbally with patients in a professional manner. * Ensure the segregation of clinical and non-clinical waste according to SSC waste policy when disposing of waste, and ensure that other staff are aware of and follow the policy. * Under the supervision of nursing staff, assist with training and supervision of new support staff while they are being orientated and inducted by showing them around the area, advising of the theatre routine. * Under the direct supervision of nursing staff, check all medical equipment required for theatre lists including diathermy, suction, tourniquet, camera, screens, light source theatre lighting, ensuring that the ventilation is on and working, as trained and in line with national theatre protocols. * Daily check stock level and replenish ensuring the environment is prepared for clinical activity. * Stock up supplies, pharmaceutical products on a daily basis. * Transport of instruments to theatre and return it to the correct allocated places. * Escorting patient that have undergone local anaesthetic back to the Day Ward. * Check serile instrument set contents lists, reporting any missing instruments, incorrect instruments and broken instrumentation to CSSD and Theatre Manager/CNM1, according to theatre policy. * Under the supervision of nursing staff, help maintain a sterile field whilst setting up the procedure trolleys, opening up packaging and equipment in a sterile manner. * Under the supervision of nursing staff, help with patient positioning, setting up of theatre equipment, including diathermy, suction, fluids and camera. * Be constantly aware of theatre scrub nurses’ needs, obtaining any extra equipment, swabs, sutures, dressings etc. as requested. * Dispose of bodily fluids; tissue and clinical waste according to training and in line with trust policy on a daily basis. * Ensure that the anesthetic rooms, recovery and day ward are adequately stocked with sheets, blankets, pillows and pillow cases. * Ensure that the operating tables are ready and waiting in the anaesthetic rooms for the next day and between cases. * Transfer patients from Recovery to Day Ward with a Staff Nurse. * Work with transport Nurse team transferring patients from Recovery to the Inpatient ward and bring patients from Inpatient ward to the theatres with the transport Nurses. When working as part of transport team take instruction of duties from Transport Nurse. * Clean trolleys and take them back to the Day Ward. Assist in the cleaning down and preparing bed bays, post patient discharge from the Day Ward. * Ensure that linen basket and bags are available in the sluice room. * Ensure that the dirty laundry is taken to the ground floor. * Check that the Prep Rooms are stocked for the following day. * Ensure that there are enough dressing gowns in the Day Ward for the following day. * Check all theatres to ensure that the Scavenging System is turned off. * Remove clinical waste bags from bins and replace with new clinical waste bags at the end of every shift in theatre, anaesthetic room and dirty utility rooms. * Check and replace all sharp bins as necessary. * Participate with the cleaning of theatre and equipment between patient visits and at the end of lists, in line with Theatre Policy. * Spot clean areas in the event of spillage of bodily fluids and other substances. * Report equipment failures to the Theatre Manager/CNM1s. In line with theatre policy. * Report any Health and Safety/hazards, Manual Handling and Infection Control issues to the Theatre manager/CNM1s. * Work with the Theatre Manager/CNM1s to ensure a safe environment is maintained in order to safeguard the welfare and safety of patients, staff and visitors. **Qualifications & Experience** Fetac Level 5 Qualification or similar relevant required. **Experience** Previous experience of working in a caring profession is desirable. Have the ability to undertake the physical demands of the role. Be motivated and able to identify potential difficulties and formulate solutions. Be free from any defect or disease which would render him/her unsuitable to hold office and be in a state of health as would indicate a reasonable prospect of ability to render regular and efficient service. Be of good character. This job description is intended to be an outline of the areas of responsibility. As UPMC and the post holder develop, this job description may be subject to review in light of the changing needs of the business. **Salary Scale:** €36,069 - €42,177 based on a 39 hour working week. Incremental credit will apply to the salary. **Equal Opportunity Statement And Benefits** **UPMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.** At UPMC we provide a total rewards program that is not only market competitive, but fair and provides growth opportunities for all our colleagues. **Performance and Recognition** – Rewards for performance that supports the goals and mission of UPMC through our annual ACES programme. **Development and Career Opportunities** – Opportunities for each employee to reach their career goals through continued learning and/or advancement. **About UPMC** UPMC is a renowned multinational academic medical centre committed to delivering people-focused care that’s close to home. Headquartered in Pittsburgh and affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh Schools of the Health Sciences, UPMC shapes the future of health through clinical and technological innovation, research and education. UPMC expands its expertise globally, bringing world-class care across continents through its UPMC International division — an owned and operated network of hospitals and ambulatory care centres in Italy, Ireland and Croatia. UPMC International brings new access to the signature specialty services of UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre, UPMC Sports Medicine and others to more people in more places around the world. In Ireland UPMC has provided high-quality healthcare in the South East since 2006. UPMC’s operations in Ireland now include UPMC Whitfield Hospital in Waterford, UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic in Dublin, UPMC Kildare Hospital in Clane, and UPMC Aut Even Hospital in Kilkenny. Outpatient care is available at the UPMC Carlow Outreach Centre, UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre radiotherapy locations in Waterford and Cork, UPMC The 4th Practice in Mallow, and across UPMC Sports Medicine Clinics in Dublin, Waterford, Limerick, Tipperary, Cork, and Mayo. UPMC has also established a nationwide Concussion Network. UPMC's Global Technology Operation Centre is based in Kilkenny.

In just a few years, we've grown from two founders to a team of 150+ professionals, including 35+ dedicated research analysts. We're recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a fully bootstrapped model - no outside investors, no growth hacks - we're on track to hit $50 million in revenue this year alone. Our Impact While our growth speaks for itself, we're most proud of the impact we've had on our members. To date, we've helped over 5,000 members worldwide grow and protect their wealth through decentralized finance. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education - we build a powerhouse of knowledge paired with an engaged community, cutting-edge technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts, all in service of one goal: helping our members achieve long-term success in DeFi and Web3. Our Vision Our goal is to build the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the undisputed gold standard in DeFi education. It's an ambitious, transformative vision - and one that's already reshaping the landscape of digital finance. Are You Ready? This is more than a job. It's a chance to help shape the future of Web3 education, one word at a time. If you're ready to sharpen your craft inside a fast-moving, mission-driven company, we want to hear from you. What Will You Be Doing? As a Junior Copywriter on our Renewals team, you'll write the words that keep our members engaged, informed, and excited to continue their journey with Decentralized Masters. You'll work closely with our Membership Directors and Renewals team to craft copy that re-engages members at renewal time and helps them see the ongoing value of their membership. * Renewal Campaigns: Write emails, SMS, and in-app messaging that drive membership renewals - from early reminders to last-chance offers * Retention & Reoffer Copy: Partner with Membership Directors to write persuasive reoffer and downsell messaging for members considering leaving * Member Storytelling: Turn member wins, testimonials, and success stories into compelling proof points that support renewal campaigns * Lifecycle Content: Support broader renewal-lifecycle content, including one-pagers, landing pages, and follow-up sequences * Testing & Iteration: A/B test subject lines, CTAs, and messaging angles, then use the results to sharpen future campaigns * Cross-Team Collaboration: Work alongside senior copywriters, marketers, and mentors to make sure every piece of copy sounds like Decentralized Masters and speaks directly to our members' goals **Requirements** What You'll Bring * 1+ year of copywriting experience (agency, in-house, or freelance) with a portfolio that shows clear, persuasive writing - recent graduates with a strong portfolio are welcome to apply * A genuine interest in finance, blockchain technology, and the democratization of financial services (crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement) * Strong writing fundamentals - grammar, clarity, and the ability to match tone across formats (email, SMS, web) * An eagerness to learn retention and lifecycle marketing copywriting, with curiosity about what makes people stay * A collaborative mindset and openness to feedback - you'll work closely with mentors and senior copywriters who will help you grow fast * Comfort managing multiple copy requests and deadlines in a fast-paced, remote environment **Benefits** What Do We Offer You? * Competitive salary * Full-time, 40 hours/week * Unlimited PTO * Flexible, remote-first schedule - work where you thrive * Annual team offsite - once a year, the whole team meets in person * Direct mentorship from elite operators across finance and crypto * A young, dynamic team of 160+ professionals across the globe * Rated 4.9/5 on Glassdoor - 32% above average for Financial Services employers If you're ready to sharpen your copywriting skills, help members stay and grow with Decentralized Masters, and be part of a team shaping the future of crypto finance, we want to hear from you!

title: Junior Legal Executive
description: **The Company** Cubic³ provides advanced software-defined vehicle solutions to over 200 countries around the world. Our powerfully smart connectivity enables leading automotive, agriculture, and transportation OEMs to deliver innovative new services and fully compliant in-vehicle experiences that customers desire, regardless of local market requirements. We believe in leadership that supports empowerment and responsibility, while recognising and developing leadership qualities across Our Team. Together we bring out the best in each other. So, whether you’re interested in joining us as an individual contributor, manager, senior leader – or someone who aspires to growing into a leadership role – we look for people who are results focused, empathetic, visionary, empowering, and who ‘champion’ our cultures and values. **The Role** Cubic³'s Legal team sits at the centre of a fast-moving, international technology business, supporting commercial negotiations, regulatory compliance and corporate governance across a broad customer and supplier base spanning multiple jurisdictions. We're looking for a sharp, curious and hard-working junior lawyer to join the team at a pivotal time, as the function moves towards is a more generalist model accelerated by the adoption of AI tooling in day-to-day legal work. This is a cross-departmental role with genuine breadth from day one. You'll play a key role in supporting the legal team through reviewing NDAs, managing templates, running contract execution and standard commercial agreements, and handling corporate filings, but this is deliberately a launchpad, not a ceiling. As you build fluency with our business, our contracting models and our stakeholders, you'll be given rapid, structured exposure to higher-value commercial lawyering: live negotiations, deal structuring and direct stakeholder management across the business. We're less interested in how many years you've clocked up and more interested in how quickly you learn, how much ownership you take, and how comfortable you are operating in a high-pace, multi-faceted environment where no two weeks look the same. **What You'll Do** * Review and triage incoming NDAs against playbook positions, escalating only where needed * Own and maintain contract templates and the contract management/execution process * Draft, review and manage standard commercial agreements (vendor, supplier, customer) ensuring that all documentation is produced with a high level of accuracy in a timely manner. * Handle corporate filings and company secretarial administration * Use AI-assisted tools to speed up document review, drafting and legal admin * Progress, with guidance from senior counsel, into supporting negotiations and managing relationships with internal stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Procurement and Product * Work across departmental lines rather than in a single practice-area silo **About You** * Qualified solicitor or barrister with c. 1 year PQE, or a legal executive with c. 2 years' relevant legal experience * Strong academic and professional grounding in contract law and commercial drafting * Genuinely curious, commercially minded, and energised by variety rather than routine * Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment and work to deadlines * Professional, reliable and proactive approach to work. * Naturally collegiate and a strong team player * Comfortable with a high volume of admin-heavy work early on, with the drive to earn more complex responsibility quickly * Organised, precise, and a clear communicator with non-legal stakeholders * Open to AI-augmented ways of working - comfortable adopting new tools to work smarter * Interest in international/cross-border commercial matters is a plus, not a requirement **Why Cubic³** * Direct, hands-on exposure to live commercial deals in a global technology business from month one * A genuinely cross-functional seat - you'll collaborate closely with teams across the company, not just within Legal * A clear, accelerated runway: strong performers are given more complex work depending on ability rather than years of formal experience * A small, senior legal team willing to invest time in your training and development * The chance to build a valued generalist in-house skillset - commercial, regulatory and governance *New hires at* Cubic³ *are required to work onsite five days a week during their six-month probation period to get to know the company, their team, and our ways of working. After probation, we offer a flexible arrangement of up to eight work-from-home days per month, provided it aligns with business needs and performance standards. This arrangement is not a given for all roles.* **Cubic³ is an equal opportunities employer and committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.**

title: Junior Privacy Analyst
description: Job Description Dunnes Stores is Ireland's leading retailer, positioned at the cutting edge of food and fashion retailing. Irish owned, we operate over 130 stores across Ireland, Northern Ireland, and Spain, as well as a growing online store. We are expanding our service and product offering to meet the evolving needs of our customers. We believe that Dunnes Stores, with its unique mix of physical stores, leading ecommerce experience and increased use of technology will continue to offer the best shopping experience to our customers - new and existing online and in stores. As part of the day-to-day operation of our data privacy function, we are hiring a Junior Privacy Analyst to join our Data Privacy team, based in our Head Office in Dublin city centre. This role is an excellent opportunity for a graduate or early-career professional with a keen interest in data privacy, compliance, or risk to gain practical, hands-on experience supporting GDPR operations within a large retail organisation. Reporting to the Data Privacy Manager, the Junior Data Privacy Analyst will primarily support the day-to-day administration of the organisation's data privacy function. The role focuses on managing data subject rights requests, responding to privacy-related queries, maintaining accurate records and logs, and supporting the coordination of data privacy assessments and risk management activities. This position is well suited to someone who is highly organised, detail-focused, and motivated to build a strong foundation in data protection through operational delivery and administrative support. **Key Responsibilities** * Support the handling of data subject rights requests, including access, deletion, rectification, queries, and complaints, by gathering information, preparing draft responses, tracking deadlines, and escalating issues in line with agreed procedures. * Operate the data privacy mailbox on a day-to-day basis by logging requests, acknowledging receipt, routing queries to the appropriate owner, and maintaining registers under the direction of the Data Privacy Manager. * Maintain accurate records and logs of data privacy activities, including request registers, incident logs, and DPIA records, to support reporting, oversight, and audits. * Assist with data privacy assessments by completing templates, collating supporting documentation, and following up on agreed actions. * Support privacy training and awareness activities by updating materials, coordinating distribution, and tracking completion across the organisation. * Provide administrative and operational support to the Data Privacy Manager, including meeting coordination, document management, and preparation of routine reports. * Develop knowledge of data protection requirements and internal processes, escalating risks, uncertainties, or non-standard issues for review. **Qualifications and Experience** * Third-level qualification in a business-related or similar discipline. * Interest in data privacy, legal, risk, or technology-focused environments. * Strong administrative and organisational skills, with high attention to detail. * Good analytical and problem-solving ability. * Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally across the business. * Proactive, positive team player with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities. * Motivation to deliver a high-quality data subject experience through accurate handling of requests and follow-through. * Support will be provided for relevant Data Protection certifications. **If this sounds like the job for you, please apply now!** **Dunnes Stores is an Equal Opportunities Employer** LNKD1\_IJ

ERR, GPG, Salary certs, Pension reports, Healthcare and Social Welfare forms) * Analysis of all payroll inputs (including joiners and leavers processes) * Management of approvals and reconciliations * Ensure adherence to documented procedures and statutory requirements * Proactively work with managers/supervisors to ensure accurate flow of information across departments (payroll inputs) * Working with the Financial Team both locally and in the region producing costing reports and costing analysis each pay period, assisting with data analysis as required * Managing the accurate recording of month end procedures * Manage the CSO (Central Statistics Office) returns on a quarterly basis and lodge data on time * Ensure the timely response to employee requests and queries, and escalate where appropriate * Provide support to wider HR team on ad-hoc duties and projects when required * GDPR compliance * Maintain strict confidentiality on all matters surrounding this role and the broader business environment. **Requirements And Qualifications** * IPASS Certification * Minimum of 1 year's payroll experience * Core Payroll system experience is a distinct advantage * Microsoft Office efficiency * Strong Excel reporting skills required * Excellent numeric skills necessary * Ability to work to tight deadlines * Meticulous accuracy, attention to detail and process driven * Strong communication and relations building skills * Ability to work as part of a team and under own initiative * Flexibility and keen sense of responsibly and commitment * Ability to remain calm under pressure

title: Piercer
description: **Why Astrid & Miyu?** We're more than a jewellery brand, we're on a mission to revolutionise the jewellery experience, and that starts with our people. We're a fast moving, values led team built on trust, ownership and growth. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to life, make an impact and grow alongside a team that celebrates each other. You’ll join a team of passionate piercers where your craft is truly celebrated and your expertise is valued * Pierce with premium implant-grade jewellery, internally threaded titanium and 14ct solid white and yellow gold, along with lab-grown diamonds and semi-precious stones **How you'll drive success:** * Champion safety and excellence, taking full ownership of the cleanliness and hygiene of your studio, while proactively managing and maintaining piercing supplies to the highest standard * Inspire our community with styling advice, executing precise and aesthetic piercings - all with a meticulous eye for detail and a genuine love for what you do * Host from the Heart, creating a warm, intentional space where every customer feels seen, valued and cared for, while holding space with empathy and compassion, especially during sensitive moments * Lead on the shop floor, sharing your piercing expertise and passion with both customers and your team, inspiring trust and elevating the energy around you **What you'll need to thrive:** * This role is suitable for any Piercers with at least 1 year experience in a studio looking for that next step in their journey * A values champion and brand ambassador, our values resonate deeply with you * You radiate positivity & enthusiasm and inspire the people around you * You’re able to stay grounded during more difficult and sensitive interactions, always leading with empathy **The Interview Process And Candidate Experience** * Values Interview: a 30 min video call with our Talent Team to get to know you better, learning more about your journey, what motivates you and how you like to work. * In-Store Technical Interview - you'll meet one of our Piercer Mentors for a Studio Set-Up & Piercing Demo, alongside your Store Manager who will chat through your experience, skill-set and what you're looking for in your next role. ***Feedback:*** *We’re committed to creating the best candidate experience we can for you. You’ll receive feedback over the phone or email at every stage in the process once you’ve had an interview so that we can set you up for success and help fuel your growth.*

title: Postgraduate Internship in Customer Analytics.
description: At AIB, our values guide how we work and how we support each other. We’re looking for someone who puts **Customer First** , takes initiative and **Owns the Outcome** , and is always looking for ways to **Eliminate Complexity** . You’ll treat colleagues and customers with fairness and **Show Respect** , and you’ll thrive in a culture built on collaboration where we **Be One Team** to deliver meaningful impact. **Location/Office Policy:** Molesworth st, Dublin (Hybrid working – 3 days in office) **Salary:** €27,500 **Duration:** 6 –months, commencing January 2027 * Are you a recent master’s graduate considering whether to pursue a PhD or begin a career in industry, OR a current PhD student interested in gaining practical industry experience? * Are you enthusiastic about causal inference and curious about whether behaviourally informed interventions work? Are you interested in using statistical and econometric tools to evaluate their effects on consumer financial decision-making? * Would you like to gain hands-on experience preparing and analysing large datasets and using data visualisation to communicate insights? **What Is The Role** The Customer Base Management team is looking for two interns to join its six-month Postgraduate Internship in Customer Analytics, commencing in January 2027. The internship is designed for candidates interested in gaining practical industry experience in causal inference and marketing analytics. You will work with large datasets to evaluate the effectiveness of direct customer communications and use data visualisation to communicate your findings. We are looking for candidates who are ready to put on their “scientist goggles”: to approach questions with curiosity, challenge assumptions with evidence, and remain open to revising their conclusions when the data points in a different direction. **This Internship Offers Opportunities To** * Apply statistical and econometric skills to real-world business questions; * Work on specific analytical projects and present your findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; and * Build your professional network through a semi-structured networking programme facilitated by the team’s people leader. **What You Will Bring** * A completed master’s degree or current enrolment in a PhD programme in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Physics, Psychology, Behavioural Science, or a related discipline with a strong quantitative component. * Proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis and a basic understanding of SQL. * Experience creating data visualisations using tools such as Python, R, Power BI or Tableau. **Why Work For AIB** We are committed to offering our colleagues choice and flexibility in how we work and live and our hybrid working model enables our people to balance their time between working from home and their designated office, subject to their role, the needs of our customers and business requirements. *Some of our benefits include;* * Healthcare Scheme * Employee Assistance Programme * Two volunteer days per year * 21 Annual leave days (Pro-rata depending on contract length) Please click **here** for further information about AIB’s PACT – Our Commitment to You. **Key Capabilities** * Promotes Innovation * Collaborates * Instils Trust * Data Analysis * Data Visualization * Statistical Modelling If you are not sure about your suitability based on any aspects of the role advertised, we encourage you to please contact the Recruiter for this role, Mia Coyne, at careers@aib.ie for a conversation. AIB is an equal opportunities employer, and we pride ourselves on being the first bank in Ireland to receive the Investors in Diversity Gold Standard accreditation from the Irish Centre for Diversity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees. Should you have a reasonable accommodation request please email the Talent Acquisition team at careers@aib.ie **Disclaimer** Unsolicited CV’s sent to AIB by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this position. AIB operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our recruitment partners. **Application deadline : October 30, 2026**

title: Powder Paint Operative

title: Program Owner, EMEA Field & Cross-Persona Enablement
description: **Summary** As Program Owner for Regional Enablement in EMEA, you turn business needs into learning that helps teams win across two focus areas: owning a portfolio of programs (onboarding, methodology, competency development) for EMEA Sales, PS, and CS, and serving as the EMEA execution partner for global enablement programs (GGS, TAM, AE, SE, CS) by adapting and localizing centrally-designed content with global Persona Program Managers. You align with other Program Owners, the relevant Persona Program Managers, and the EMEA Sales/Adoption Business Partner to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across the region. **Job Description** The Guidewire Enterprise Readiness Team aligns information, learning, and communication experiences to support readiness and adoption goals across all Guidewire personas — Customer, Partner, and internal teams. Our goal is to build an enterprise training and enablement strategy that becomes a competitive differentiator, ensuring employees, customers, and partners maximize their impact with Guidewire Cloud. **Key Responsibilities** * Owned Programs (EMEA Field: Sales, PS, CS) *You are accountable for design, delivery, and continuous improvement of these programs.* * Own coordination of the functional onboarding program for the EMEA Field organization, including activity assignment and EMEA-specific adaptation. Success is measured by role readiness at the 6-month mark. * Ensure new hires are registered for Field Onboarding or technical certification courses as assigned; gather ongoing feedback to improve programs. * Deliver key methodology training and Field Onboarding sessions for the EMEA region; support all-hands and regional sessions as guided by the EMEA Sales/Adoption Business Partner. * Develop ad-hoc role/functional training to elevate skill development across the EMEA region, aligning delivery with in-person learning events. * Apply readiness methodology across all owned programs: validate and consult on needs assessment, readiness plans, content curation/development, and partner sign-off on plan, content, and outcome measurement. * Partner with the EMEA Readiness Business Partner on training tied to new hire programs and field events (Regional Kick-Offs, Sales Reviews, Quarterly Field Updates, etc.). * Support the broader readiness transformation strategy — shifting from a push to a pull model using AI capabilities to deliver content in context. * Own the operational execution of recurring EMEA regional enablement mechanisms, including planning, stakeholder coordination, participant readiness, communications, action tracking, follow-through and continuous improvement, in partnership with the EMEA Sales/Adoption Business Partner. * Cross-Persona Execution Support (GGS, TAM, AE, SE, CS — EMEA) *Each of these personas has a distinct global Persona Program Manager who owns overall program design. You are accountable for reviewing, adapting, and localizing that content for EMEA delivery, and for regional execution quality — not for originating the program.* * Partner with global GTM Program Owners to ensure programs are regularly enhanced, communicated, and measured against business expectations; ensure programs are loaded into the appropriate LMS and changes are communicated to EMEA leadership. * Serve as the EMEA counterpart to each persona's global Persona Program Manager (GGS, TAM, AE, SE, CS); review centrally-designed content — virtual sessions, eLearning, and in-person events — and adapt/localize it for EMEA relevance (language, regional examples, market context). * Schedule and, where appropriate, co-facilitate delivery of these localized programs for EMEA audiences. * Register and track EMEA participants, monitor regional completion, and feed regional performance and content feedback back to each Persona Program Manager for continuous improvement. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** **For Owned Programs (Section A)** * Stakeholder Satisfaction: internal/external satisfaction with strategic partnership and execution * Business Performance: correlation of readiness programs to measurable performance improvement, including new hire readiness and skill attainment * Program Usefulness Score: average post-learning usefulness score * Program Completion Rate: 80% of target audience completing programs within the designated timeframe * New Hire Readiness: 80-90% of Field managers rating employees functionally prepared after 6 months * Program Management: adherence to program methodology, task tracking via tools such as Monday.com * Mechanism Sustainability / Execution Reliability: recurring regional mechanisms operate on schedule, with clear ownership, dependencies and follow-through, and with decreasing reliance on individual contributors for day-to-day coordination. **For Cross-Persona Execution Support (Section B)** * Regional Completion Rate: 80% of EMEA target audience completing each localized program * Delivery Adherence: on-time, on-scope regional rollout against the Persona Program Manager's plan * Localized Content Quality: EMEA-specific usefulness/feedback score on the adapted content, tracked separately from the global program's overall usefulness score (which stays with the Persona Program Manager) **Required Skills / Experience** * 4–6 years in enablement, learning & development, onboarding, or related fields within enterprise software; 1–2 years facilitating live or virtual training. P&C insurance or enterprise SaaS experience preferred but not required. * Instructional design and facilitation: advanced curriculum design, learning activities, dynamic presentation/facilitation. AI- fluency to create content and explore modalities. * Business acumen and P&C industry knowledge to ensure strategic relevance and practical adoption. * Complex project management: plan and execute multi-workstream programs; maintain accurate weekly status in the project tracking system. * Communication and adaptability: excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; able to multitask and adapt to a changing environment. * Strategic stakeholder collaboration: influence alignment with EBPs, global program owners, and cross-functional leaders; translate needs into effective enablement solutions. * Integrity, Rationality, & Collegiality: operate within Guidewire values — truthful relationships, evidence-based decisions, professional collegiality. * Tools proficiency: Google Workspace; LMS and survey/analytics tools; authoring platforms; virtual delivery tools; AI tools; project tracking (e.g., Monday.com). * Language Proficiency in English and at least one other European language. (Preference for French, Spanish, German, Italian) * AI- fluency in content creation, program execution, and workflow automation. We are an AI-forward company and want to leverage the tools we have to optimize our targeted deliverables and process flows. **About Guidewire** Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC. Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position. Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. title: R&D Engineer
description: Turmec has an exciting opportunity for an R&D Engineer to join our expanding team. The successful candidate will play a key role in the research, development and continuous improvement of Turmec's products, equipment and engineering solutions within the recycling and material handling industries. Working closely with Engineering, Production, Sales, Supply Chain and other key stakeholders, the R&D Engineer will be responsible for developing innovative engineering concepts through design, prototype, testing, validation and implementation. The successful candidate will be technically strong, curious and solutions-focused, with the ability to challenge existing designs and identify opportunities to improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability and cost effectiveness. **Responsibilities** * Research and develop current products, new technologies and engineering solutions for the recycling and material handling industries. * Develop engineering concepts from initial idea through detailed design, prototype, testing, validation and implementation. * Design components, assemblies and material handling equipment using CREO/SolidWorks or equivalent 3D CAD software. * Produce detailed 3D models, drawings, specifications and technical documentation. * Plan, coordinate and conduct prototype builds, trials and engineering testing. * Analyse test results and use findings to optimise product performance, reliability and functionality. * Identify opportunities to improve existing Turmec products through design optimisation and value engineering. * Participate in design reviews, product integration and technical problem-solving. * Investigate engineering issues and undertake root-cause analysis to develop effective and sustainable solutions. * Work closely with Production and Supply Chain to ensure new designs are suitable for manufacture, assembly and ongoing service. * Evaluate new materials, components, technologies and manufacturing methods. * Manage assigned R&D projects, including specifications, timelines, testing, documentation and project close-out. * Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation relating to R&D activities, design changes, testing and validation. * Collaborate with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders where required to understand technical requirements and develop appropriate solutions. * Keep up to date with emerging technologies and engineering developments relevant to Turmec’s products and markets. * Promote a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and engineering excellence across the business. **Qualifications** Relevant third-level qualification/Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering or a related engineering discipline. **Required Skills & Experience** * Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a mechanical design, product development, R&D or similar engineering role. * Strong mechanical design and engineering fundamentals. * Experience using CREO and/or SolidWorks is desirable * Experience in prototype development, product testing and design validation would be advantageous. * Experience within material handling, recycling, manufacturing, heavy engineering or machinery environments would be beneficial. * Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. * Ability to take an engineering concept and develop it into a practical, manufacturable solution. * Commercial awareness with an understanding of cost, manufacturability and value engineering. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong interpersonal skills. * Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Production, Supply Chain and other departments. * Self-starter with the ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Ability to manage competing priorities and work to agreed project deadlines. * Innovative and inquisitive approach, with a willingness to challenge existing designs and identify better ways of doing things. **Benefits** * Competitive Salary * Monday – Friday * Flexible working hours * Health Insurance/Wellness Program * Pension & Death in Service Life Cover * 21 Days Annual Leave

Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution. **What You’ll Do** * Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32-bit drivers to DMA 64-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. * Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. * Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). * Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform-independent abstractions. * Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. * Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers * Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near-real-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. * Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. * Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C++ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields (Bachelor’s, Master’s, PhD) * Any of the following:- C, C++, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. * Strong analytical skills * Ability to communicate effectively in a collaborative and highly technical team environment * Intellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technology **Additional Information** The working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.

You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. * **Drive.** You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut. * **All. These. Benefits.** Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location.
